dedupe_keys.name: stochastic nonlinear dynamic analyses for earthquake ground deformations

description: Stochastic Nonlinear Dynamic Analyses for Earthquake Ground Deformations is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Ross Boulanger, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). This repository presents a workflow for performing Nonlinear Dynamic Analyses (NDAs) with stochastic fields for evaluating earthquake ground deformations at sites with interlayered and/or spatially variable subsurface soils. Site data from cone penetration tests (CPTs) are processed for determining representative soil properties and spatial correlations using Jupyter Notebooks in Python. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Geostatistics; Spatial Variability; Finite Difference; FLAC; Site Investigations; Soil Dynamics; Liquefaction; Lateral Spreading; Cyclic Softening; Case Studies. Published 2022-08-17. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GPL-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
